subevent: At least four civilians were killed and 10 others were wounded in a mortar attack in northern Faryab province on Thursday morning.
Around 11:00 am local time, a mortar round landed in a market in Shareen Tagab district of Faryab province.
The mortar was fired by the Taliban to target the security forces, but all the victims are civilians who were at the market to shop.
The Taliban has not commented on the attack.
